milestone_name: Multi-Vendor Production Engine & Zero-Leak Tether Core

completed_tasks.name: 10,000-Packet Adversarial USB Packet Fuzzing Test Harness (QUAL-02)
Milestone-Level Quality Gate Audits & Verification (QUAL-03 & QUAL-04)

decisions.decision: Eliminated O(N) full card scanning in favor of native PTP Host Control (0xD214) and Interrupt IN event streaming (<15ms)
decisions.rationale: Prevents camera LCD 'USB COMMUNICATING' freeze and excessive battery drain on Fuji bodies

decisions.decision: Implemented continuous 0x9116 DIGIC event pump for Canon EOS bodies
decisions.rationale: Prevents Canon shutter lock and DIGIC ring buffer overflow during high-speed burst tethering

decisions.decision: Auto-remediate Sony 0xD2C1 property to PC+Camera mode
decisions.rationale: Prevents volatile DRAM loss during unexpected USB disconnects

decisions.decision: Used DirectByteBufferPool and OkHttp UsbStreamRequestBody for zero-copy streaming
decisions.rationale: Streams RAW payloads directly from USB to Google Drive without staging 50-100MB files into flash memory
